title: Tiny, cute toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fc8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5aa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='head' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ec8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='13' height='52' rx='6.5' fill='url(#handle)'/>
  <!-- handle highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='47' y='44' width='3' height='44' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd1e8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- rubber grip dots -->
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='58' r='1.6' fill='#ffe3f0'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='66' r='1.6' fill='#ffe3f0'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='74' r='1.6' fill='#ffe3f0'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='82' r='1.6' fill='#ffe3f0'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='28' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#8fd8f5'/>

  <!-- brush head -->
  <rect x='40' y='10' width='21' height='22' rx='9' fill='url(#head)'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#dff4ff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- bristles: three rows -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <rect x='43' y='12' width='2.6' height='6' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='47.5' y='12' width='2.6' height='6' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='52' y='12' width='2.6' height='6' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='56.5' y='12' width='2.6' height='6' rx='1.3'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#c9f0ff'>
    <rect x='43' y='20' width='2.6' height='5' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='47.5' y='20' width='2.6' height='5' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='52' y='20' width='2.6' height='5' rx='1.3'/>
    <rect x='56.5' y='20' width='2.6' height='5' rx='1.3'/>
  </g>

  <!-- toothpaste blob on bristles -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='11' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='10' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#e9fbff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='10.5' r='1.4' fill='#b5ecff'/>

  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <path d='M67 32 l1.6 3.4 3.4 1.6 -3.4 1.6 -1.6 3.4 -1.6 -3.4 -3.4 -1.6 3.4 -1.6z' fill='#fff9a8'/>
</svg>
